title: Doctors rule out poison in trainee IPS officer’s suicide attempt case
description: Trainee IPS officer M Uday Krishna Reddy, who was admitted to hospital on Monday after an alleged suicide attempt, did not consume any poisonous substance, doctors said on Tuesday, a day after he was booked for allegedly sexually harassing a fellow IPS probationer at the Sardar Vallabhbhai National Police Academy in Hyderabad
